html.body: The Pentose Phosphate Cycle, also known as Hexose Monophosphate Pathway (HMP), is a pathway of glucose turnover alternative to glycolysis and occurs in most species. Its major function is the production of reducing equivalent (in form of NADPH) and of pentoses and tetroses for biosynthesis reactions (nucleoside and amino acid syntheses) in variable ratios. free text=Biochemiscal Pathways - An Atlas of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Edited by Gerhard Michal free text=Biochemistry by Voet and Voet free text=Color Atlas of Biochemistry by Jan Koolman and Klaus-Heinrich Rohm
